# Cargo Drawers and Storage Solutions

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Cut foam-core material, assemble a cabinet box with flaps using plywood and piano hinges, then carpet if desired. [t1685]

[Partial] Cut plywood, wedge it into the cargo area or secure with wire turnbuckles. [t1685]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Cut foam-core material to match the rail pattern.
2. Test fit the foam core in the cargo area.
3. Adjust dimensions based on the test fit results.
4. Lay out all primary pieces excluding flaps and fascia.
5. Cut out those primary pieces.
6. [Partial] Mark out rabbits, dados, and other grooves.
7. Cut out the marked rabbets, dados, and grooves.
8. Perform a dry test fit of the components.
9. Make any necessary adjustments to the parts.
10. [Partial] Begin assembly using glue on all edges plus nails or screws as needed.
11. Fit the completed cabinet box into the cargo area.
12. [Partial] Measure and mark up foam-core for the left and right flaps.
13. [Partial] Repeat the marking process for the drawer fascia.
14. Cut out the marked flap and fascia pieces.
15. Attach the flaps using piano hinges.
16. Secure the drawer fronts with screws.
17. Apply epoxy to desired areas like cabinet tops and drawer interiors for water resistance.
18. [Partial] Cover the entire cabinet box with carpeting if desired.

_Procedure reported by [t1685]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-cargo-drawers-2000-2004.1495/>_

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1685] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Cut plywood to dimensions slightly larger than the design specifications.
2. [Partial] Wedge the box tightly into the cargo area or secure it with wire turnbuckles at front and rear sides.

</details>

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use glue on all edges during assembly for strength. [t1685]
- Epoxy the cabinet tops and drawer interiors to prevent water damage. [t1685]
- [Partial] Use a 6' x 9' outdoor rug for the top surface to prevent items from sticking. [t1685]
- [Partial] Consider using HDPE plastic instead of carpet if expecting heavy mud and dirt. [t1685]
